discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 3008cec: directory listings carry a per-path generation, so a response that a newer listing has superseded is dropped. Interval polls skip folders still loading rather than superseding them, which keeps slow SSH listings from being cancelled forever. Test holds an old root listing, lands a newer one, then resolves the old one and checks the fresh entries stay.

Fixed in 7a9bf2ae36. ShortcutRecorder now calls suspendShortcuts() for the duration of a recording, and both QuitHoldHandler and the page-level shortcut listener check areShortcutsSuspended() before acting (the quit handler also cancels any hold in progress). The recorder also uses stopImmediatePropagation() so other capture-phase listeners on window don’t see the keydown. Covered by the “suspends shortcuts until every suspension is released” test in keybindings.test.ts.

Fixed in c739776f. The overview fetch now carries a generation (same pattern as the usage fetch): `loadOverview` captures it and checks it after every await, before any state write, and Sign Out bumps it. A response that lands after Sign Out therefore never reaches `applyAccountUser`, so the signed-out account cannot be written back into the context or its localStorage cache.

Sign Out also clears `overviewLoading` itself, since the stale fetch no longer clears it on the way out (the signed-out prompt would otherwise stay behind the spinner).

Test: `AccountView sign-out > drops an overview fetch that lands after sign-out` loads a user, starts a second overview load via an org switch, signs out, then resolves the pending `fetchMe` with the old user and asserts `applyAccountUser` ran once and the signed-out prompt is showing. Reverting the guard makes it fail with `applyAccountUser` called twice.

Agreed, good catch. Fixed in f92a94ca3. The unmount-only cleanup in `useChatSession` now also sets `streamFlushTimerRef.current = null` after clearing the timer, so once the app is shown again `schedulePendingStreamFlush()` arms a new timer, and any text buffered before the hide goes out with the next flush. I made the same change to the `turnEndReconcileTimerRef` cleanup for consistency; that one couldn't stall, since its scheduler always clears and re-arms. New test: `keeps flushing streamed text after the app is hidden and restored` hides and restores the hook with `<Activity>` while a flush is pending. Without the fix the assistant message stays empty; with it, the text arrives.

Fixed in 0093e45f1. The mouse and Ctrl+V paths now share a single `pasteFromClipboard` callback with one in-flight guard (same shape as `InputBar`): it returns early while a read is pending and releases the ref 100ms after settling, so two rapid right/middle clicks or a repeated Ctrl+V can no longer append the same clipboard contents twice.

The bracketed-paste path (`usePaste`) is left unguarded deliberately — it receives the text inline from the paste event and performs no async clipboard read, so there is no duplicate-read window there.
